name: com.kazukikuriyama.maplibre-unity
description: MapLibre GL JS port for Unity, written in pure C# with no native C/C++ plugins (a single ~250-line WebGL JSLib bridges IndexedDB for the on-disk tile cache). Renders raster and vector tiles with full MapLibre Style Spec support (paint/layout properties, expressions, zoom functions, filters, symbols, camera animations).
